blocks.text: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. is set to open up about life beyond the presidency when he sits down with singer and host Gary Valenciano for the season finale of “Unshaken With Gary V.” The episode, which premieres on Monday, Oct. 5 at noon on YouTube and major podcast platforms, features Marcos in a more personal conversation with Valenciano. The two-hour-plus episode was recorded inside Valenciano’s private music studio, a roughly 20-square-meter space where the singer has worked on music over the years.
